description: Lock the contract between Electron renderer, Electron main, and the v2 native/helper replay engine. Full design in `.story/notes/N-007.json` (25 numbered sections). Summary: three processes, two IPC boundaries — renderer↔main over Electron `ipcMain.handle`/`webContents.send` (channels namespaced `cove/<domain>/<verb|noun>`, contextBridge + contextIsolation + sandbox), main↔helper over length-prefixed JSON-RPC 2.0 on UDS (`$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cove-screen-recorder/engine.sock`, mode 0600) on Linux/macOS and a per-user-ACL'd named pipe on Windows. Methods: `capture.listSources/requestSession/startStream/pauseStream/resumeStream/stopSession/setRegion/setFramerateHint/setCursorMode`, `replay.save/snapshot_release/recoverable_sessions/discard_recovered_session/restore_recovered_session/export_start/export_cancel`, `engine.version/health/setLogLevel/shutdown/diagnosticsBundlePath`. Events: `capture.{sessionReady,formatChanged,streamPaused,streamResumed,sessionLost,diagnostics}`, `encoder.{probeResult,selected,fallbackEngaged,runtimeError,backPressure,diagnostics}`, `replay.{segmentDiagnostics,recoveryAvailable,snapshotPinned,snapshotReleased}`, `export.{queued,started,progress,stalled,completed,failed,cancelled,rejected}`, `engine.{ready,shutdownStarted,logLine,stateChanged,crashed}`. Helper supervision: main spawns the helper after `app.whenReady()`, verifies the helper binary's sha256 sidecar (matches global release rule) and protocol version, adopts a live orphan helper if its PID file points to a same-user `cove-replay-engine` process, otherwise scrubs stale `engine.{sock,pid}` and spawns fresh. Crash detection via child exit event + EOF on the socket + 10 s `engine.health` heartbeat timeout. Restart loop: immediate, +2 s, +10 s; 3 failures within 60 s → sticky `engine.unavailable` requiring `engine.restart`. No silent auto-resume: crash mid-recording returns the UI to IDLE and offers any recoverable session via `replay.recoveryAvailable`. v1.1.0 no-leftover-process invariant preserved by moving subprocess lifecycle entirely into the helper (PR_SET_PDEATHSIG on Linux, Job Objects on Windows, no `pactl` anywhere — PipeWire audio API used directly); main scrubs only the socket and PID file. Renderer state model: explicit FSM `IDLE→PICKING→SESSION_PENDING→STREAM_PENDING→READY→RECORDING→SAVING→SNAPSHOT_HELD→EXPORTING` with sticky `SESSION_LOST` and `ENGINE_DOWN`; `RECORDING` is reachable ONLY via `capture.sessionReady` (kills Issue #3 at the UI layer); `SAVING` does NOT block the HUD; three separate clocks for active session time / replay window duration / export progress, never conflated (kills Issue #4). Settings surface: replay.durationSeconds (10..1800; presets 30/60/120/300/600), capture.mode (monitor/window/region), capture.region, capture.framerateHint, capture.cursorMode, capture.rememberRestoreToken, encoder.preference (auto/nvenc/vaapi/qsv/libx264; hint only — helper may downgrade per N-004), export.maxCompatibility, export.outputDir, export.overwritePolicy, hotkeys.{saveReplay,toggleRecording,pauseResume} (defaults `CommandOrControl+Shift+R`, `+Shift+F9`, unbound; carries forward T-002 work), diagnostics.verbosity, diagnostics.keepDiagnosticsBundles, startup.autoLaunch, startup.startMinimized. Region UX (Issue #1 absorption): `capture.mode === "region"` runs portal monitor pick, then an app-owned frameless overlay window draws a darkened mask and lets the user drag a rectangle; rectangle goes to `capture.setRegion`; helper crops at the encoder boundary; mid-recording region adjust is supported without re-pick. Export panel: per-row stage badge + progress + ETA + cancel (DISABLED past MUXING per N-006 §11); stalled overlay clears on next progress; toast on completion with "Show in folder"; toast on rejection ("Too many pending exports"); recoverable-session banner on engine boot. Diagnostics surface: helper-side rotating per-session JSON dumps under `$XDG_STATE_HOME/cove-screen-recorder/diagnostics/`, main-side `app.getPath("logs")/main.log`, renderer-side in-memory `engine.logLine` buffer; "Copy diagnostics bundle" zips the lot with sensitive fields redacted. Error mapping: every helper reason code maps to ONE user-facing string + at most one CTA; unrecognised codes surface verbatim for triage. Dependency probe: blocking modal if `xdg-desktop-portal`, `pipewire`, libx264, or the helper binary is missing/tampered; informational GPU vendor/driver report. Packaging implications (no change in this session): helper as `extraResources` per target, sha256 sidecar per artifact (global rule), Linux `.deb` Depends on pipewire ≥ 0.3.x + xdg-desktop-portal ≥ 1.18, Windows code signing of the helper in the same step as the main exe. Linux-first; Windows path shape preserved (transport switch + `WgcSource` slot + `AmfEncoder` slot already in N-003/N-004). Issues #1, #3, #4 are structurally absorbed (see N-007 §18). No source files changed; only `.story/` planning artifacts. Codex review not needed.
title: Plan Electron UI integration with native/helper engine
